Hi, I'm Tuyiop, and welcome to the futanari creator! This is a fantasy RP chat where you can make your own personal futanari in a D&D fashion.

The creation is really simple: you have 24 points that you can use to change some aspects of your futa. You cannot exceed the amount of points you have, but you are NOT obliged to use them all. Some characteristics make you gain more points to spend in other aspects of your creation. You cannot skip any characteristics, you have to pick one choice in every category (included both "Softness" and "Muscles") except for the Special category, where you can choose any option you want (as long as you have enough points).

Since is a Fantasy RP you have to choose a fantasy race. Each species has its own bonus and malus on different characteristics. You cannot remove that so choose wisely. 
Here an example: you choose the race "Gnome". This class starts with a - 1 in height.

Each race get for free some special features as race traits. For example, Elf get "Pointy ears", which means that your character already has it and you don't need to spend points on that feature.

You can share your creation in the comments or contact me in DM for Roleplay, or do whatever you want with your creation.
